Usage: droide resume [options] [sessionId] [prompt...]

Resume a session (shows a session picker without an id)

Arguments:
  sessionId                           Session id or session link to resume
                                      directly
  prompt                              Prompt to send to the resumed session

Options:
  --fork                              Fork the selected session and resume the
                                      fork
  --last                              Skip the picker and resume the most recent
                                      session in the current folder
  --settings <path>                   Path to runtime settings file merged for
                                      this process only
  --append-system-prompt <text>       Append custom text to the end of the
                                      system prompt
  --append-system-prompt-file <path>  Append file contents to the end of the
                                      system prompt
  --cwd <path>                        Working directory path
  -w, --worktree [name]               Run in a git worktree
  --worktree-dir <path>               Deprecated: set the worktree directory in
                                      settings instead
  --auto <level>                      Autonomy level: low|medium|high
  --use-spec                          Start in spec mode
  --disable-builtin-skills            Disable built-in skills shipped with the
                                      CLI
  -h, --help                          display help for command
